diagnosis: Intestinal T-cell lymphoma NOS involving the stomach
legend: A dense lymphoid infiltrate is seen in the lamina propria, interdigitating between the gastric glands.

diagnosis: Intestinal T-cell lymphoma NOS involving the stomach
legend: Medium-sized to large pleomorphic lymphocytes are seen, which have dispersed chromatin and prominent nucleoli.

diagnosis: Intestinal T-cell lymphoma NOS involving the stomach
legend: The neoplastic cells are diffusely positive for CD4 (shown here), lack CD8 expression, and display strong CD30 expression. The neoplastic cells are also positive for granzyme B, indicating a cytotoxic phenotype.
